visualScope: The complete mapped Roman wall circuit around Lugo, rounded towers, ten open gateways, sloping rampart walk, stone parapets and the Santiago gate shrine.
limitations: Deck grades and arch dimensions are reconstructed from the mapped circuit, available terrain and exterior views. The station stair is fitted on the town side of its mapped path.
The two wall outlines and mapped passages establish placement. Individual masonry repairs and other stair flights are outside the model scope.
